changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.comment: CHECK: allowlist.provider is one of the supported OAuth providers.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE allowlist ADD CONSTRAINT ck_allowlist_provider CHECK (provider IN ('google', 'discord'))
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE allowlist DROP CONSTRAINT ck_allowlist_provider

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.comment: CHECK: account.provider is one of the supported OAuth providers.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE account ADD CONSTRAINT ck_account_provider CHECK (provider IN ('google', 'discord'))
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE account DROP CONSTRAINT ck_account_provider

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.comment: CHECK: account.roles is one of the two values the API writes.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE account ADD CONSTRAINT ck_account_roles CHECK (roles IN ('user', 'user,admin'))
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE account DROP CONSTRAINT ck_account_roles

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.comment: CHECK: namespace_grant.namespace is one of the platform namespaces (mirrors AccountStore.NAMESPACES / isValidNamespace).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE namespace_grant ADD CONSTRAINT ck_namespace_grant_namespace CHECK (namespace IN ( 'hugmesh-pki', 'hugmesh-backend', 'hugmesh-frontend', 'hugmesh-games', 'observability'))
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE namespace_grant DROP CONSTRAINT ck_namespace_grant_namespace

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.comment: FK: bff_session.account_id references a real account; a deleted account takes its sessions with it (a session is only ever minted for an existing account row in AccountStore.newSession).
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE bff_session DROP CONSTRAINT fk_bff_session_account

changeSet.author: hugmesh
changeSet.comment: CHECK: the route-access string columns the API requires non-blank (AdminController.addRouteRule rejects blank gateway/url_pattern/role).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE gateway_route_access ADD CONSTRAINT ck_gra_nonblank CHECK (length(trim(gateway)) > 0 AND length(trim(url_pattern)) > 0 AND length(trim(role)) > 0)
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE gateway_route_access DROP CONSTRAINT ck_gra_nonblank
